svg.text: LinkerBot (灵心巧手) · Motion Control & VLA
Closed-loop control of a 16-DoF hand over CAN/RS485 (linkage-coupling compensation, URDF
calibration); built a 30 Hz teleop and retargeting pipeline that feeds VLA training.
Prototyped perception-to-feedback interactions for the intelligent cockpit, and benchmarked the
in-car pipeline latency against the HMI response budget.
Profiled and hardened a real-time control loop for a gimbal subsystem: tracked down jitter in the
control path and cut it before long-duration bench tests.
Validated sensor-fusion and extrinsic calibration for ADAS features, and built the evaluation tooling
that flagged calibration drift before road tests.
